brief.headline: Push price to ₹0.65–0.80/pc (market says headroom exists at volume) and qualify Manjushree as second source to break single-supplier lock

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm cap (currently in ₹0.85–0.95/pc band)
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec for this cap; typical band today is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, verdict MARKET-FAIR — we want the lower end of that headroom

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no reason to ease terms when price is the priority

brief.financialLeverage: Empire publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or how tight their cash is. Our ₹67.47 L spend is real money, but without their revenue we don't know if we're 1% or 10% of their book. The plan here leans on the market data — the ask band shows room — and on lining up Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr converter, pharma bottles and caps, health score B 65/100) as a qualified second source so we're not locked in.

evidence.point: We spend ₹67.47 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
Market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import unit value (a raw-material benchmark) is 87.61 ₹/kg
Manjushree Technopack (₹2569.83 Cr, health B 65/100) is India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter and covers pharma bottles, caps, preforms — a top second-source candidate
Mold-Tek Packaging (₹946.50 Cr, health B 73/100) is a listed, profitable rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma — another robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr, health B 65/100); makes pharma bottles, caps, preforms — top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr, health B 73/100); strong and profitable across pails, containers, pharma packaging

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (market lead to qualify)
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead from public web research (India-Pan, medium confidence) — verify capability and price before issuing RFQ

risks: Empire's financials aren't public — we can't see if they're healthy or struggling, so watch for any supply hiccups and move fast on Manjushree qualification
The market headroom (₹0.65–0.80) assumes higher volume or looser spec — if our order size or tight spec doesn't fit that, they may push back hard
We're single-sourced with Empire today — until Manjushree (or Mold-Tek) is audited and priced, we have limited walk-away power
Market backups like Reliance and Chemco are leads only (medium confidence) — they need verification before we can treat them as real alternates
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, and we'd like to lock in ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm cap — market research shows that's fair at our volume — and we're also qualifying a second source to secure supply long-term.
